They check for things like predictability of language called perplexity, repetitiveness and style patterns and burstiness which basically means what's the variation in sentence length and complexity. Human writing usually has more natural variation whereas AI writing tends to be more smooth and predictable and based on these signals they then make a estimated guess whether the writing is fully AI generated human AI mix or completely human written. But here's the catch. AI detectors can never be 100% sure. A very well-ritten human text can be flagged as AI and even AI generated text with a few intentional mistakes or edits can be passed as human written.
